verses.text: Wan sja stiempoal k'inh yik snachajkoti tas aj yelnakkot heb' israel t'a Egipto, haton yik swa'an ixim pan heb' malaj yich.
Haxo heb' winh sat sacerdote yet' heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés ix sayan modo tas ol aj smilancham Jesús heb' winh t'a k'ub'eltak, yujto xiw heb' winh t'a heb' anima.
Ay jun winh skuch Judas, winh aj Queriot. Yetb'eyum sb'a winh yet' heb' winh uxluchwanh sk'ayb'um Jesús, palta a winh Satanás ix och t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winh sk'umej heb' winh sat sacerdote yet' heb' winh yajal yaj t'a heb' winh stanhwan stemplo Dios. Ix yalan winh tas ol yutok yak'anoch Jesús t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh.
Yuj chi' te wach' ix yab' heb' winh. Ix yak'an strato heb' winh yet' winh t'a jantak tumin ol yak' heb' winh t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix scha'an yab' winh tas ix yal heb' winh. Ix och ijan winh sayani tas syutej winh yak'anoch Jesús chi' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh t'a elk'altak.
Ix k'och sk'ual swa'an ixim pan heb', haton ixim malaj yich ayemi, yik smiljipaxcham nok' kalnel yik sna'ankot heb' tas aj yelnakkot heb' t'a Egipto.
Haxo Jesús ix chekanb'at winhaj Pedro yet' winhaj Juan, ix yalani: --Ixikek, b'at b'o'ek tas ol kab'lej t'a jun k'inh tik, xchi t'a heb' winh.
--¿B'ajtil a gana sko b'o'o? xchi heb' winh t'ay.
--Ayik ol ex k'och t'a yol chonhab', ay jun winh ol ilchajel eyu'uj, kuchb'il jun ch'ub' ha ha' yuj winh. Tzex och tzak'an yuj winh, masanto tzex k'och yet' winh t'a spat.

Ol eyalan t'a winh aj pat chi: Icha tik ix aj yalankot ko k'ayb'umal t'ayach: ¿B'ajtil ay jun a cuarto b'aj ol in wa yet' heb' winh in k'ayb'um yik sko na'ankot tas aj yelnakkot heb' ko mam kicham t'a Egipto? xchikoti, xe chi t'a winh.
Haxo winh ol ch'oxan jun niwan cuarto t'ayex t'a jun cha'anh. Listaxo yaji. Haxo ta' ol he b'o tas ol kab'lej chi', xchi Jesús t'a heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at heb' winh. Haxo ix k'och heb' winh, ix yilan heb' winh to ix elk'och icha ix aj yalan Jesús chi'. Yuj chi' hata' ix sb'o heb' winh tas ol yab'lej t'a jun k'inh chi'.
Ayik ix k'och yorail, ix k'och Jesús yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh sk'ayb'um, ix och hoyan heb' winh wa'el t'a spatik te' mexa.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a heb' winh: --Toxon nab'il wu'uj to in gana tzin wa heyet'ok t'a jun k'inh tik, yakb'an manto in chamok.
Swal t'ayex, manhxa b'ak'inh ol in wa t'a jun k'inh tik, masanto ol och junelxo ayik ol wach' och Dios Yajalil, xchi t'a heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ank'e wa'an jun waso. Ix yak'an yuj diosal t'a Dios yuj. Ix yalanxi t'a heb' winh: --Chaek jun tik. Mol uk'ejek.
Yujto swal t'ayex, manhxalaj b'ak'inh ol wuk' yal uwa tik, masanto ol wach' och Dios Yajalil, xchi t'a heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ank'e wan jun ixim pan. Ix yak'an yuj diosal t'a Dios yuj ixim. Ix xepanb'at ixim t'a heb' winh. Ix yalani: --Ha jun tik, haton in niwanil tik ol ak'jok eyu'uj. Waek ixim. Tze k'ulejnhej jun tik, yik tzin he na'ankoti, xchi t'a heb' winh.

Icha pax chi' ix yutej junxo waso ayik toxo ix lajwi swa heb', ix yalani: --Ha jun ay t'a yol jun waso tik sch'oxanel jun schab'il strato Dios toto ix b'oi. Yuj in chik'il ol el eyu'uj ol elk'och jun trato chi'.
Palta a winh ol in ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ol in milanchamok, ayek' winh wet' t'a jun mexa tik.
Ha in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, yowalil ol in paxok, ichataxon yaj sb'okani. Palta a wal winh ol in ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' chamel chi', te chuk yik winh, xchi Jesús t'a heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal-lan yab' junjun heb' winh, ¿mach onhtaxlaj ol kak'och t'a yol sk'ab' chamel chi'? xchi heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix laj stelan sb'a heb' sk'ayb'um yuj mach junok heb' ek'al yelk'ochi.
Haxo Jesús ix halan t'a heb': --Ha heb' rey t'a junjun nación, yajal ton yaj heb'. Yet' heb' yajal, wach' heb' yalan heb' anima.

Ha exxo tik, manh eyutok he b'a icha heb' chi'. Tato ay junok mach t'a he kal tik ek'al yelk'ochi, yik'okab'emta sb'a icha junok unin. Hanhejtona' tato ay junok yajal yaj t'a he kal, ichaokab' junok chekab' syutej sb'a.

K'inalok tz'och junok niwan wa'el. ¿Mach junok más niwan yelk'och tze na'a? ¿Am jun k'ojanem wan swa'i, mato a jun wan yak'an serwil? Haton jun k'ojanem wan swa chi' más niwan yelk'ochi, palta a in tik ayinek' t'a he kal icha junok tz'ak'an serwil.
Ha ex tik, ix he tek'b'ej he b'a eyek' wet'ok ayik ix ja juntzanh ya'elal t'a wib'anh.
Yuj chi', icha in yutej ko Mam Dios in yak'anoch yajalil, icha chi' ol ex wutej pax ex wak'anoch yajalil.

Yuj chi' ol yal he wa wet' t'a jun in mexa b'aj ay in och yajalil chi'. Hanhejtona' ol ex em k'ojjab' t'a junjunok he k'ojnub'. Haxo eyoch chi' yajalil t'a heb' lajchawe' makan ketisraelal, xchi Jesús t'a heb' sk'ayb'um chi'.
Ix yalanpax Jesús: --Ach Simón, ina ix sk'an spermiso winh Satanás t'a Dios, yujto snib'ej winh tzex yak' prowal icha tz'aj ixim trigo schayaji.
Palta ix in tewi wal t'a Dios u'uj, yik max ik'el a k'o'ol t'ay. Ha ach tik, ayik ol meltzajxok och a pensar t'ayin, tzak' stek'anil heb' uk'tak, xchi Jesús.
Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Simón chi': --Mamin, b'ekan in k'ol in b'at et' t'a preso, wach'chom tzin cham het'ok, xchi winh.
--Pedro, swal t'ayach, ayik manto ok' nok' kaxlanh t'a jun ak'wal tik, oxel ol ik'el t'a ib'anh to manh in ojtakok, xchi Jesús chi' t'a winh.

Ix yalanxi Jesús t'a heb' sk'ayb'um: --Tze nakoti, ayik ex in chekannakb'at junel, maj eyik' he moral, maj eyik' he tumin, maj eyik'paxb'at he xanhab'. ¿Tom ay tas yak'nak palta t'ayex ta'? xchi t'a heb'. --Ma'ay, malaj tasi, xchi heb'.
Haxo tiknaik, mach ex ay he moral, he tumin, tzeyik'b'at heyet'ok. Mach ex malaj eyespada, tze chonhel he chumpa, tze manan eyiko'.

Yujto swal t'ayex, yowalil ol elk'och t'a wib'anh icha tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios, b'aj syalkan icha tik: Icha tz'utaj heb' anima chuk, icha chi' ix utaj winh, xchi. Jantaknhej wab'ixal tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios chi', yowalil ol ujokelk'ochi, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yal heb' sk'ayb'um chi' t'ay: --Mamin, ina chab' k'e'en espada tik, xchi heb' t'ay. --Yechelxo chi', xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix elta Jesús t'a yol jun pat b'aj ix wa heb' chi', ix b'at t'a tzalan Olivo ichataxon smodo. Ix och pax tzak'an heb' sk'ayb'um yuj.
Haxo ix k'och ta', ix yalan t'a heb': --Lesalwanhek, yik manh ol ex ak'jok prowal, xchi t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix sb'esanel sb'a t'a stz'ey heb'. Icha am snajatil sb'at junok jul-lab', icha chi' ix b'ati. Haxo ta' ix em kuman, ix lesalwi.
Ix yalan icha tik: --Mamin, tato a gana, ik'el jun ya'elal tik t'a wib'anh, palta manhok icha in gana, palta ichaokab' wal a gana, xchi.
Ixlajwi chi', ix sch'oxan sb'a jun ángel ix kot t'a satcha'anh. Ix ul yak'an stek'anil.
Ix te och pitz'an t'a spixan. Yuj chi' yelk'olal ix lesalwi. Haxo yalil tz'em t'a sat lu'um, kalan yaj yet' chik', icha wal yem tz'uj yem t'a sat lu'um chi'.
Ixlajwi slesalwi, ix meltzajxikot b'aj aykan heb' sk'ayb'um chi'. Haxo ix k'och t'a heb', waynakb'at heb', yujto ix te och pitz'an kuselal t'a spixan heb'.
Yuj chi', ix yalan t'a heb': --¿Tas yuj tzex te wayi? K'eanhek wa'an, lesalwanhek, yik wach' manh ol ex meltzaj t'a he patik ayik ol ex ak'jok prowal, xchi t'a heb'.

Wanto slolon Jesús chi', ix k'och heb' tzijtumal anima. Haxo winhaj Judas, yetb'eyum sb'a yet' heb' uxluchwanh sk'ayb'um Jesús chi', a winh b'ab'el sk'och yuj heb'. Ix snitzanb'at sb'a winh stz'ub' sti' Jesús chi'.
Haxo Jesús chi' ix halan t'a winh: --Judas, ¿tom icha tik tz'aj in ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' chamel a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik? xchi.
Haxo heb' ayek' yet' Jesús chi', ayik ix yilan heb' tas wan sja t'a yib'anh ix sk'anb'an heb' t'ay: --Mamin, ¿tzam yal ko xikan heb' t'a k'e'en espada tik? xchi heb' t'ay.
Wal t'a jun rato chi', ay jun winh t'a skal heb' sk'ayb'um Jesús chi' ix tzepanel schikin jun winh schekab' winh sat sacerdote t'a swach'.
Haxo Jesús ix halan t'a heb': --Aktejek, k'okb'ilxo chi', xchi t'a heb'. Haxo Jesús ix yaman schikin winh chi', yet'nhej chi' ix ochxikani.

Ha heb' winh sat sacerdote, heb' winh yajal yaj t'a stemplo Dios yet' heb' winh ichamtak winak ay yopisio, ix k'och heb' winh syam Jesús chi'. Yuj chi' ix yal Jesús chi' t'a heb' winh: --¿Tas waj tzeyila'? ¿Tom kuchb'um in t'a heb' sk'ulan chukal yuj chi' tzex ja t'ayin yet' k'e'en espada yet' te te'?
Ayinnhej ek' eyet' t'a yamak'il stemplo Dios t'a junjun k'u, palta maj in eyama'. Palta hato tiknaik yorail he k'ulan jun tik yet' yipalil winh aj k'ik' k'inal, xchi t'a heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yamji Jesús yuj heb' winh. Ix yik'anb'at heb' winh t'a spat winh sat sacerdote chi'. Haxo winhaj Pedro, najat tzak'anto sb'at winh yuj.
Haxo t'a yamak'il ti' pat chi' ix yak'och jun k'ak' heb' winh. Ix och hoyan heb' winh t'a sti' te', ix em k'ojan heb' winh. Ix em k'ojan pax winhaj Pedro chi' t'a skal heb' winh.
Haxo jun ix criada, ayik ix yilan ix to k'ojanem winhaj Pedro chi' t'a sti' te' k'ak' chi', ix och k'elan ix t'a winh, ix yalan ix: --Ha jun winh tik, yetb'eyum sb'a winh yet' Jesús tik, xchi ix.
Haxo winh, elanhchamel ix yik'el winh t'a yib'anh, ix yalan winh: --Ach ix, manh wojtakok jun winh tzal chi', xchi winh t'a ix.
Junanto rato chi', ay junxo ix och k'elan t'a winh, ix yalani: --Ha ach tik, etb'eyum a b'a yet' heb', xchi t'a winhaj Pedro chi'. --Wal yel ma'ay, manh wetb'eyumoklaj in b'a yet' heb', xchi winh.
Ay am tom junok hora chi', yelk'olal ix yal junxo winh: --Wal yel a jun winh tik, yetb'eyum sb'a winh yet'ok, yujto aj Galilea heb', xchi winh.
--Toton ma'ay, manh wojtakok juntzanh tzal chi', xchi winhaj Pedro chi' t'a winh. Ayik wanto yalan juntzanh chi' winh ix ok' nok' kaxlanh.

Ix kot k'elelok Jesús Kajal chi' t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix snakot winh tas ix yalkan Jesús. Ichaton tik ix yutej yalankan t'a winh: Ayik manto ok' nok' kaxlanh t'a jun ak'wal tik, oxel ol ik'el t'a ib'anh to manh in ojtakoklaj, xchi t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix sb'eselta sb'a winh t'a skal heb'. Ix te ok' wal winh sik'lab'il.
Haxo heb' stanhwumal Jesús ix och ijan heb' sb'uchwaj t'ay. Ix laj smak'an pax heb'.
Ix smakan sat heb'. Ix stz'itanb'at sti' heb'. Ixlajwi chi', ix sk'anb'an heb' t'ay: --Al t'ayonh mach tzach mak'ani, xchi heb' t'ay.
Manh jantakok tas ix yal heb' t'ay yik sb'uchwaj heb' t'ay.

Haxo ix sakb'i, ix smolb'an sb'a heb' ichamtak winak ay yopisio t'a skal heb' israel, heb' winh sat sacerdote yet' heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés. Ix yik'anb'at Jesús heb' winh t'a yichanh winh sat yajal. Haxo ta' ix sk'anb'ej heb' winh t'ay:
--Al t'ayonh, ¿tom a ach tik Cristo ach? xchi heb' winh t'ay. --Nab'anhej swal t'ayex, ¿tom ol he cha eyab' t'ayin?
Tato a in tzin k'anb'ej junok tas t'ayex, ¿tom ol eyal t'ayin? ¿Tom ol in eyak'el t'a libre?
Palta a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, a tiknaik ol in k'ochkan k'ojan t'a swach' k'ab' Dios, haton jun masanil tas syal yuj, xchi Jesús t'a heb' winh.
Masanil heb' winh ix k'anb'an t'ay: --¿Tom Yuninal ach Dios jun? xchi heb' winh t'ay. --Ha in ton tik Yuninal in, icha tzeyal chi', xchi t'a heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal heb' winh. --¿Tasto tz'och testigo ku'uj? Yujto a onh wal lak'an ix kab' yalan winh, xchi heb' winh.
